description: Seeed Studio XIAO W5500 Ethernet Adapter v1.2 or later (XIAO ESP32-S3 Plus, 16MB flash, 8MB PSRAM) preconfigured as a Z-Wave proxy for a Home Assistant Connect ZWA-2 in its USB-C port; with the stick occupying USB-C the adapter is PoE powered over its wired Ethernet. Earlier adapter revisions lack the W5500 interrupt wiring this config uses. One of many possible Z-Wave proxy setups — this one is available off the shelf.
